title: Actual coefficient-layer and previous-quotient objects
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $(A,I)$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], $M$ an object of the derived category of completed coefficient modules, and $n\geq0$. Write $R_j$ for the actual sheaf of rings at $A/I^{j+1}$ and $q:R_{n+1}\to R_n$ for its specified quotient map. The map $u$ is the morphism $R_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_q R_n$ of rank-one module sheaves induced sectionwise by $q$. Let $J_n=\ker u$. Define $L_n=M_{n+1}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_{n+1}}J_n[0]$, using the derived tensor of [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. Define $E_n$ to be the localization of the restriction of scalars, along $q$, of the canonical complex representative of $M_n$. All kernels, representatives and tensor constructions are actual library constructions; none is an arbitrary witness of an unproved existence assertion.
